versions.changelog:
Initial release — introduces video editing via RunComfy with multiple edit types.

- Supports restyle, background swap, outfit swap, motion transfer, color grade, and packaging swap edits.
- Automatically selects the best model and endpoint from the RunComfy catalog based on your video edit request.
- Handles talking-head, product, and short-form video edits up to 1080p.
- Integrates with local RunComfy CLI for direct, fast, and scalable video editing.
- Triggered by a range of common video edit intents and phrases.
